responsibility: Defines `EvalCtxt`, the solver’s central per-query evaluation context, including its delegate-backed inference state, nested-goal queues, universe and opaque tracking, proof-tree integration, root-goal entry points, and helper operations for adding goals, normalizing aliases eagerly, querying coherence/const/opaque services, and coordinating nested evaluation safely.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is centered on the reusable per-query execution state and mechanics. It defines `EvalCtxt`, nested-goal storage, probing/canonicalization support, delegate-facing helper methods, and eager alias-to-infer rewriting, rather than assembling candidates, exposing inspection types, defining the top-level `solve` module surface, or specializing normalization of `NormalizesTo` goals.
